pr_title: Use an abstract lock layer to allow distributed lock between multiple Gitea instances

issue_context.title: replace sync module
issue_context.body:
replace "code.gitea.io/gitea/modules/sync" with a cluster aware one ( #13791)

ref https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/19520/files#r859289575

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/7b089c465d9f851454be91ca209ab26782648a45/services/pull/pull.go#L32-L33
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/7b089c465d9f851454be91ca209ab26782648a45/services/repository/transfer.go#L21-L23
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/7b089c465d9f851454be91ca209ab26782648a45/services/wiki/wiki.go#L30-L31
comments:
The first one could be replaced by a unique queue at the moment to prevent there are two tasks for one pull request.

The second one could be resolved by a database transaction with optimistic lock.

review_comments: maybe we want to move the log to inside redisLockService, this "lock.Unlock" doesn't really provide information specific to this function, and then we can just `defer lock.Unlock()` here
